in_sanskrit.name: कलाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kalash is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kalasha’ which means a large, open-mouthed vessel or pot. It is often used to store water or other liquids. The name is also used metaphorically to refer to a source of abundance, prosperity, and blessings.

in_hindi.name: कलाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kalash in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit, meaning a large, open-mouthed vessel or pot.

in_tamil.name: கலாஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Kalash is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kalasha’, which means a large, open-mouthed vessel or pot. In Tamil, the word ‘Kalasham’ is used to refer to the vessel.

in_telugu.name: కలాశ

in_marathi.name: Kalash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Vessel, pot for sacred water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The Sanskrit word Kalash refers to a pot or a vessel used to store sacred water or other offerings. In Hindu mythology, the Kalash represents the cosmic ocean from which the universe originated. It is also a symbol of abundance and prosperity.
